My buddy has created a card game and will be running a Kickstarter to help get it off the ground, we already have the basic funding levels but I figured I would ask you guys what your favorite stretch goals were and what you like in your rewards.
Buddy of mine is about to launch a Kickstarter, what are things you like to see and what are some rewards you enjoy getting?

The only reward I care about is a copy of the game. Honestly that's where the bulk of your money is going to come from anyway, I don't think you really need tons of reward tiers. However, if you feel that you need them then consider enhancing the copy of the game that I'm getting (the only thing that I care about). Wooden or metal pieces, for example, or a wooden board, or fancy dice, or a fancier rule book.

Don't get bogged down with this stuff, but there's probably nothing wrong with charging a ridiculous amount for the ultra deluxe special edition given that a donation to a project is not supposed to be cost-efficient. Just keep the regular edition at a reasonable price, and make sure you don't promise what you can't deliver, and you're fine.

That's what we decided to go with just mostly the game and multiple copies of the game at higher tiers. The only stretch goal we would have is plastic cards for an upgrade. The game wouldn't translate to a ultra deluxe edition so we're keeping it simple so people can just get the game. Thanks for the incite.
